'''Shears''' come in four kinds in Matcha Flavoured. The vanilla shears are renamed '''iron shears'''.

== Usage ==
Shears work as in vanilla, and all shears and hoes can mine glow lichen. Looting is allowed on shears; sheep shearing tables add up to 3 extra wool per Looting level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/enchantable/looting_compatible.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/shearing/sheep/white.json}}</ref>
